rules.name: Infiltration
rules.description: When Outflanking, partisan units ignore the -1 modifier to the Order test foir coming onto the table.

rules.name: Hidden Bomb
rules.description: At the start of the game place three bomb markers anywhere outside the enemy deployment zone. The actual explosive device is not actually where the marker is located but is nearby. The first enemy unit to move within 6” of the marker must roll a die; on a result of 3 or less the bomb is revealed to be a dud, on a 4 or 5 nothing happens but the bomb remains active (roll again for the next enemy unit), on a 6 the bomb explodes, hitting the unit with a heavy howitzer effect.  After exploding the marker is removed. Bombs never affect Partisan units no matter how close they are to a marker.

rules.name: Fieldcraft
rules.description: During set-up, any partisan unit starting the game Hidden may start the game already in Ambush. In addition, in the first turn of the game, all partisan infantry units treat all Rough Ground and Obstacles as Open Ground for the purposes of movement.

rules.name: Local Area Knowledge
rules.description: Units in this platoon do not suffer the -1 penalty for attempting to come onto the table as reserves.

rules.name: SAS Support
rules.description: You may only include SAS jeeps or armoured jeeps if you take an SAS infantry section or weapons team. The Jedburgh team Supply Co-ordination rule only applies to the Partisan squads in this force and not the SAS.

rules.name: To the Barricades!
rules.description: The partisan player using this platoon gets up to 100pts of barricades or barbed wire sections (page 151). These must be placed before any units are set up, but after players have chosen sides. They may be placed anywhere in that player's half, or on any road on the board regardless of whose side of the board it is on.

rules.name: Captured and Recaptured
rules.description: Any H39, R35, S-35, Flammpanzer B2(F), or FT17 may be taken at any troop quality (Inexperienced, Regular, or Veteran) and do not suffer from the Unreliable rule.

sharedRules.name: Marksman
sharedRules.description: The marksman and assistant count as normal members of the squad at all times, except when the squad is issued a Fire order (including from Ambush). When resolving a Fire order, the assistant does not fire his own weapon, and you roll the marksman's shot separately, against the same unit targeted by the squad, using the Sniper special rule. Note that the presence of a marksman has no effect on the way the squad sets up.

sharedRules.name: 'Who dares win'!
sharedRules.description: To represent their special training and motivation, SAS units have the fanatics special rule.

sharedRules.name: Frontal Armour
sharedRules.description: This vehicle cannot be damaged by small arms hits from the frontal arc but will still be pinned as normal

sharedRules.name: Conflicting Loyalties
sharedRules.description: This unit counts as Green. However when rolling after the first casualty , use the following table instead: 1-3: The unit immediately goes Down, in addition gains the Shirkers rule for the rest of the game. 4-6: The unit immediately becomes Regular and Stubborn for the rest of the game.

sharedRules.name: Strike from the Shadows
sharedRules.description: Squad counts as observers/snipers for set up purposes. They may always start the game using the Hidden rule.

sharedRules.name: Supply Co-ordination
sharedRules.description: Before the game begins roll a die and consult the following: 1-2 Miss drop: No further effects, 3-5 Partial drop: Each infantry squad in a single platoon may exchange a single weapon for a SMG for free (even if this is not available to the unit or it has already taken the maximum number of upgrades). 6: Full drop: In addition to Partial Drop (see above), one member of an infantry squad may replace their weapons with a LMG for free, another member becomes the loader (even if this is not available to the unit or it has already taken the maximum number of upgrades). Note: you must replace the upgraded models with new models depicting the actual weapons. If you cannot do so, the rule has no effect.

rules.name: German machine gun
rules.description: Roll one extra shot when firing the MMG.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6 and apply modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the player activating the Intelligence Officer may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players attempt to activate this ability simultaneously, each must roll 1D6. The higher score wins and immediately uses this ability, but the losing player may attempt to use his ability on another turn instead.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6 and apply modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the player activating the Intelligence Officer may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players attempt to activate this ability simultaneously, each must roll 1D6. The higher score wins and immediately uses this ability, but the losing player may attempt to use his ability on another turn instead.

rules.name: Inspiring Presence
rules.description: Upon receiving his order dice (except for Down), a chaplain may select one friendly unit within 6" and roll a D6, applying the following modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the chaplain may remove 1 pin from the selected unit.

rules.name: Non Combatant
rules.description: The chaplain is there to support the soldiers, not win battles. A chaplain unit cannot be used to claim or contest objectives.

rules.name: Self-defence only
rules.description: Clergymen are not soldiers and will not take part in hostile actions - they cannot fire any weapon, nor assault enemy units. If your chaplain is equipped with a pistol, it can only be used in close quarters if the enemy assaults him (including firing it at the assaulting enemies as a reaction, if applicable).

rules.name: LMG Loader
rules.description: For every LMG purchased for the squad, another member becomes the loader.

rules.name: Slow...Pitifully Slow!
rules.description: Slow tank, and in addition may not make a double-speed Run move at all. It can still be given a Run order, but moves it basic speed only.

rules.name: Gun assembly
rules.description: To simulate the fact that the gun was actually transported disassembled, when the gun is unlimbered the artillery unit suffers a pin. When the gun is limbered, the mule team (and consequently the transported artillery unit) suffers a pin.

rules.name: Stubborn (Mule)
rules.description: When taking an order test and doubles are rolled, the mules become stubborn and refuse to cooperate even if the order test was passed. Place the order dice to Down and add 1 pin marker to th eteam. This rule does not apply if Fubar is rolled.
